Name: PinkStations Cotton Candy Interiors
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[font=sans-serif][b][size=5]~PinkStations Cotton Candy Interiors~[/size][/b]

A pretty interior recolor based on bright & cute colors! 

This mod recolors all of the interior assets and is customizable! There are 3 colorable options (Trims, Walls, and Floors) that lets you change the interior to look however you'd like! The color options are black, blue, green, pink, purple, and white! The mines and caves are also colored! Side note: I have colored the hay item so that it will match the recolor when you place it in the animal feeding troughs but this is able to be disabled.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]The entire mod is able to be disabled as well so if you'd like just one aspect but not the others you can do that![/font]

[font=sans-serif]Please see the README.txt document for all configurability options and descriptions![/font]

[font=sans-serif]If you'd like everything to match check out my other mods <3[/font]
[font=sans-serif]~ [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531][font=sans-serif]PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor[/font][/url]
[font=sans-serif]~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25658]PinkStations Cotton Candy Interface[/url] [/font]
[font=sans-serif]~ Matching furniture coming soon <3[/font]
[font=sans-serif]
Requirements:
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] ( This is not required but HIGHLY recommended for ease of changing configurable options! )

How to Install:
~ Download and then unzip
~ Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
~ Run the game and enjoy the beautiful valley!

If you find anything you think is wrong please let me know! :)[/font]
